explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/872: in the primitive-set saturation game on {2..n}, can the game be guaranteed to last at least εn moves for some ε > 0 and large n? Open. L n is the Prolonger-first minimax value of the terminal size (the number of moves), computed by a finite recursion with legal moves preserving primitivity. The page notes that the turn order is unspecified; fixing Prolonger first follows the forum and is documented. The statement asserts ∃ ε > 0 with L n ≥ εn eventually. Faithful.
